headline: Public hearings on zoning variances and permits for properties on University Avenue, Roberts Street, Butman Road, West Albert Street, and Appleton Street.
summary: The board will hear a withdrawal request and several variance and special permit applications for homes and a business, including new construction and a pet grooming business. It will also approve minutes, set the 2027 meeting schedule, and elect officers.

plain_text:
City of Lowell  
Zoning Board of Appeals Agenda  
  
10/15/2026 at 6:30 PM  
  
The City of Lowell Zoning Board of Appeals will hold a meeting on Thursday, October 15, 
2026 at 6:30 PM.  
  
Meetings will be held in the Mayor ’s Reception Room  at 375 
Merrimack Street, Lowell MA 01852 with public welcome and by using 
remote participation as follows: 
 
Members of the public may view the meeting via ltc.org, or local cable 
channel 6. Those wishing to speak regarding a specific agenda item 
shall register to speak in advance of the meeting by sending an email to 
dricker@lowellma.gov,  pcutrumbes@lowellma.gov AND 
mbrundage@lowellma.gov indicating the agenda item and a phone 
number to call so that you may be issued zoom link to the meeting. If 
no access to email, you may contact Development Services at 978-674-
4144. All requests must occur prior to 4:00PM on the day of meeting.  
 
For help with zoom please visit: Joining a Zoom meeting – Zoom Support 
 
 Review all application documents online at: https://www.lowellma.gov/1099/Zoning -Board   
 
I. Continued Business 
 
ZBA-2026-15  
Petition Type: Variance  
Applicant: TLGLE, LLC  
Property Located at: 123 University Avenue, 01854  
Applicable Zoning Bylaws: Section 6.1  
Petition: The Lowell Zoning Board of Appeals will hold a public hearing to hear all interested persons relative to an 
application by TLGLE, LLC to convert the existing building at 123 University Avenue into two (2) ground- floor 
commercial units, and twelve (12) studio apartment. The subject property is located in the Traditional Mixed -Use 
(TMU). The proposal requires Variance approval per Section 6.1 for relief from the minimum off -street parking 
requirement, and for any other relief required under the Lowell Zoning Ordinance.  
 
*PLEASE NOTE: THE ABOVE APPLICATION IS REQUESTING A WITHDRAWAL WITHOUT 
PREJUDICE* 
 
ZBA-2026-36  
Petition Type: Special Permit and Variance  
Applicant: Jeffrey Ciccone  
Property Located at: 37-39 Roberts Street, 01854  
Applicable Zoning Bylaws: Sections 4.3, 4.5, and 4.5  
Petition: The Lowell Zoning Board of Appeals will hold a public hearing to hear all interested persons relative to an 
application by Jeffrey Ciccone to retain the existing three -family home at 37 Robert Street; and to construct a single -
family home and Accessory Dwe lling Unit (ADU) at 39 Robert Street. The subject property at 37 Robert Street is 
located in the Traditional Two-Family (TTF) zoning district. The subject property at 39 Robert Street is located in the
Traditional Single-Family (TSF) zoning district. The proposal at 37 Robert Street requires a Variance per Section 5.1 
for relief from minimum lot size, minimum lot area per dwelling unit (LA/DU), minimum side yard setbacks; a 
Variance per Section 4.3.5 (4)  for relief from garage side yard setback; a Variance per Section 6.1.4 for relief from 
minimum off-street parking spaces; and any other relief required under the City of Lowell Zoning Ordinance. The 
proposal at 39 Robert Street requires a Variance per Section 5.1 for relief from minimum lot size, minimum lot area 
per dwelling unit (LA/DU), minimum frontage, maximum Floor-Area-Ratio (FAR), minimum lot width; and any other 
relief required under the City of Lowell Zoning Ordinance.  The proposals also require  a modification of the Special 
Permit per Section 4.5 recorded on June 1, 1998, at the Middlesex North Registry of Deeds.  
 
ZBA-2026-37  
Petition Type: Variances  
Applicant: Mullane Construction, LLC  
Property Located at: 384 Butman Road, 01852  
Applicable Zoning Bylaws: Section 5.1  
Petition: The Lowell Zoning Board of Appeals will hold a public hearing to hear all interested persons relative to an 
application by Mullane Construction, LLC to construct a single -family home at 384 Butman Road. The subject 
property is located in the Suburban Single -Family (SSF) zoning district. The project requires Variance approval per 
Section 5.1 for relief from the minimum frontage, minimum lot area, and minimum lot area per dwelling unit 
requirements, and for any other relief required under the Lowell Zoning Ordinance. 
 
ZBA-2026-39  
Petition Type: Variance  
Applicant: Thuhong Vu and Danny Nguyen  
Property Located at: 37 West Albert Street, 01851  
Applicable Zoning Bylaws: Section 5.1  
Petition: The Lowell Zoning Board of Appeals will hold a public hearing to hear all interested persons relative to an 
application by Thuhuong Vu and Danny Nguyen to construct an addition with a two-car garage underneath at 37 West 
Albert Street. The subject propert y is located in the Traditional Single -Family (TSF) zoning district. The proposal 
requires a Variance per Section 5.1 for relief from minimum side yard setbacks and maximum Floor to Area (FAR) 
ratio and any other relief required under the City of Lowell Zoning Ordinance.     
 
 
II. New Business 
 
ZBA-2026-40 
Petition Type: Special Permit 
Applicant: Gold Star Pet Grooming, Inc. 
Property Located at: 183 Appleton Street, 01852 
Applicable Zoning Bylaws: Section 12.4.3 
Petition: The Lowell Zoning Board of Appeals will hold a public hearing to hear all interested persons relative to an 
application by Gold Star Pet Grooming, Inc. to operate a pet grooming business at 183 Appleton Street. The subject 
property is located in the Urban Mixed-Use (UMU) zoning district. The proposal requires a Special Permit per Section 
12.4.3 to operate a pet grooming business in this zone and any other relief required under the City of Lowell Zoning 
Ordinance.   
 
III. Other Business 
 
Minutes for Approval:  
9/28/2026 
 
2027 Zoning Board of Appeals Schedule 
 
Election of Officers
Per Order of the City of Lowell Zoning Board of Appeals – Van Pech, Chairman  
New business to be advertised by September 27, 2026 and October 4, 2026
